title: Diagnosis of the K>=10 ceiling in the frozen exact minimum pass
question: Stage292 established that K>=10 is unreachable because the frozen minimum pass stage43_partial_fpt.solve_partial returns status "unknown" after a 3600 s budget even on the smallest K=10 bank case (|R|=20, 37 backbone edges). This stage determines WHICH phase of that search explodes, whether the realised growth in K matches the paper's 2^O(K) poly(B) shape, and whether the dominant cost is removable without touching the frozen solver.

pipeline_phases.P2_zero_faces: for mask in range(1 << len(A)) with A = S u N(S); counter mass_faces; theory bound 2^(4K-8)
pipeline_phases.P4_active_bases: stage43_partial_fpt.strict_vertex basis enumeration C(m, d), d = |S|+1; counters vertex_bases, local_lp_calls, interval_lp_calls, enumerated_lp_calls, zero_dimensional_lp_calls, eliminated_equality_rank

instrumentation: Entirely external. The frozen modules are imported, never modified: (a) the budget knobs seconds/max_states/max_bases/max_faces that solve_partial already exposes are used to take geometric work prefixes, so the cumulative time-vs-work curve separates per-face overhead from per-basis LP cost; (b) the statistics dict solve_partial already returns supplies every counter at stop; (c) cProfile around the call supplies function-level tottime shares as an independent cross-check; (d) a static census replicates only the preamble and the control flow that fixes the face count, with no LP work, giving exact phase-1 and phase-2 counts.

measurement_plan.k_ladder_note: The Stage287 bank contains caps {2,3,5,7,10,12} only; there are no K=8 or K=9 bank families. K=8 and K=9 are therefore realised by sweeping the solver cap knob on a fixed K=10 case, which isolates cap as the sole variable (maxweight = cap-2, |A| <= 4*cap-8, d = |S|+1 all depend on cap alone). This is declared as the one scope substitution of the stage.

resource_budget.per_run_rlimit: RLIMIT_AS enforced in a forked child
resource_budget.per_run_wall_backstop_s: SIGALRM above the solver seconds budget
resource_budget.retention: every run retained, including timeouts and failures

decision_rules.intrinsic_vs_artefact: The ceiling is called INTRINSIC if the realised per-K growth factor of the dominant counter is within the shape the paper bound allows (face count <= 2^(4K-8), supports and bases 2^O(K)) AND no reformulation of the dominant phase reduces the realised exponent. It is called an IMPLEMENTATION ARTEFACT if the dominant cost admits a reformulation that provably visits strictly fewer objects without changing the answer.
decision_rules.prototype_gate: A prototype is built only if the profile identifies a single dominant and clearly removable cost. Any prototype lives in a NEW module and must agree with the frozen solver on the minimum source count on EVERY case where both complete. A single disagreement is a stop-and-report, not something to patch around.
decision_rules.reporting: Counts and time shares are reported, not impressions. Any number resting on a truncated or budget-limited run is labelled as such.
